Interpretation: Mike is corresponding with 5 friends via mail. He stopped corresponding with two of them. So he is now corresponding with 3 people. Each of those 3 send him two messages per week, each message consists of 5 pages. He replies in the same way: he sends two messages per week, each 5 pages. So for each friend, he writes 2 messages * 5 pages = 10 pages per week. He replies with 10 pages as well? Wait: "يرد عليهم بنفس الطريقة" means he replies in the same way: he sends two messages per week, each 5 pages. So he writes 10 pages per week per friend. So total pages he writes per week: 3 friends * 10 pages = 30 pages. He writes one page every 6 minutes. So time per page = 6 minutes. So total minutes = 30 pages * 6 minutes = 180 minutes. Convert to hours: 180 minutes / 60 = 3 hours. So answer: 3 hours.

Check: Did we double count? He writes 10 pages per friend per week. Yes. So 30 pages. 6 minutes per page. 180 minutes = 3 hours.

Thus answer: 3.
